signal: MadeAi (CapeStart) actively pushing its GenAI clinical platform with new white papers and a May 2026 webinar

email.body1:
Kevin, saw MadeAi has been pushing hard on the GenAI clinical platform, fresh white papers and a recent webinar driving demand.

When marketing spins up that much air cover, the usual bottleneck is sales coverage: more life-sciences accounts showing interest than the team can actually work before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for MadeAi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for MadeAi.

Most sales orgs riding a content surge can't actually say how many meetings they need to book to convert that interest into pipeline, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble. Reps end up buried in research and CRM work instead of selling.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings MadeAi needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for MadeAi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how MadeAi's reply rate likely compares to other AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kevin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Demand-gen waves are their own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to MadeAi either way.
